status: ART ONLY: these are authored sprite sheets and art-review composites, not emulator captures, obtainability proof, live-rendering proof or gameplay acceptance.
rights: Original code-native pixel geometry, authored from silhouettes and anatomy in the Shared Horizons brief. No traced, downloaded, image-generated or third-party creature pixels.
recovery: Return to walking after settle; no fourth cast pose. Effect pixels are owned by the separate effect renderer.

briefs.name: Lintail
briefs.silhouette: A slim leaf-furred marten with a cream triangular face, tiny round ears and one forked leaf tail; separated front paws and long rear body distinguish it from Hingelet.
briefs.motion: Bounds low, tail forks close on landing; casts plant paws, stretch one tail ribbon, then recoil.

ability.name: Hem Draw
ability.field: Pull one cloth-tagged light carriage one socket toward the cast origin along its authored straight rail; side approaches refuse. Never moves the player.
ability.combat: A narrow strip travels outward, then returns along the identical clear segment. Outward damage1 or returning damage2, never both on one enemy; spacing favors the return.

briefs.name: Loomarten
briefs.silhouette: Long upright marten with two connected leafy shoulder pennants, a slim visible waist, short round ears and the same single split tail; open space between raised arms and chest.
briefs.motion: Forepaw step then trailing-tail sweep; casts gather shoulder pennants, weave an angled hem, then fold them.

ability.name: Corner Hem
ability.field: Guide that cloth carriage through one marked right-angle rail corner selected by one fresh cardinal edge in the first8 active updates. Each leg requires fresh visible contact.
ability.combat: One two-leg ribbon turns once at a visible elbow, total travel64px. Each leg clips independently against solids and no enemy takes more than2 total damage.

briefs.name: Cindercup
briefs.silhouette: A round orange puffin-like chick with a pale bowl-shaped down collar, short dark bill, tiny separate wings and broad charcoal feet; breast remains a living face-bearing body.
briefs.motion: Short alternating waddles; collar contracts, receives a warm ember, then opens with a soft pulse.

ability.name: Warm Vessel
ability.field: Gather warmth from a marked warm plate, then release the current cast into its adjacent seam after a fresh R. One fixed local transfer, no carried heat across rooms.
ability.combat: After a visible charge, fresh R releases one radius12 pulse at the fixed cast origin; damage2. No release by update30 dissipates harmlessly; no automatic healing.

briefs.name: Mantlewick
briefs.silhouette: Tall rounded wading bird with a continuous hood of warm down, long exposed neck, two short wing elbows and broad grounded feet; retains Cindercup's dark bill and pale collar.
briefs.motion: Slow neck-leading steps; hood closes, one wing cups a coal, then the hood settles.

ability.name: Hearth Veil
ability.field: Transfer heat between one source and one shielded target on a short straight bench; a manually placed hood must leave the marked vent open.
ability.combat: A stationary crescent catches at most one eligible ordinary hostile shot, then releases a short forward ember on fresh R; damage3 only after a catch,1 without. No boss-shot reflection.

briefs.name: Talusnip
briefs.silhouette: A pointed-nosed armadillo with three pale overlapping shoulder bands, low upright ears, a bare face and a broad flattened fan tail; no shell dome or goat horns.
briefs.motion: Front claws tap twice before hindfeet catch up; casts fan the tail, lean forward, then resettle.

ability.name: Measured Nudge
ability.field: Move one tagged counterweight exactly one notch away from the caster on a three-notch rail; end stops and an occupied destination refuse without movement.
ability.combat: A short ground wedge hits once for2 and nudges only ordinary movable enemies up to8px if the destination is clear; bosses take normal damage without displacement.

briefs.name: Stratodillo
briefs.silhouette: Long low armadillo with four raised offset shoulder bands, two wide digging forepaws and a tall open fan tail; a diagonal gap separates bands from its snout.
briefs.motion: Heavy front-left/front-right tread with delayed fan-tail sway; casts brace, press two distinct beats, then relax.

ability.name: Terrace Measure
ability.field: Choose left or right notch during the first8 updates and settle a tagged weight there only after its two foot pads receive the two visible beats; no arbitrary terrain creation.
ability.combat: Two spatially separated ground pulses, one near then one far. Enemies take at most3 total, and the near empty gap rewards deliberate range choice.

briefs.name: Gleamray
briefs.silhouette: A small diamond freshwater ray with curled pectoral tips used as feet, two high bright eyes, a pale smiling underside and one slender tail; grounded, not free-swimming.
briefs.motion: Alternating fin-tip steps and a soft back ripple; casts cup the fins, tilt a clear water lens, then flatten.

ability.name: Shallow Prism
ability.field: Tilt one marked water-lens tray to one of two pictured bearings; a beam must visibly reach both lens and recipient along clear authored segments.
ability.combat: A short forward water blade stops at its first wall. A fresh early cardinal edge sets one of two small lateral offsets; damage2, no ricochet.

briefs.name: Foldcurrent
briefs.silhouette: Wide connected ray fins fold into an asymmetric W around an exposed central face; long tail ends in a single broad fan, with open fin arches above the ground.
briefs.motion: Fin arches alternate like a walking cloth; casts fold one wing, release two unequal glints, then lower.

ability.name: Paired Prism
ability.field: Light two adjacent marked receivers from one tray in a fixed near-then-far sequence after selecting its manual shutter; both clear segments must be demonstrated.
ability.combat: A near water blade and delayed far glint share one cast and once-per-enemy ledger; maximum3 damage, each clipped to visible geometry.

briefs.name: Rivetusk
briefs.silhouette: A squat russet boar with a blunt living snout, two unequal flat silver tusks, a square mane and a short corkscrew tail; tusks sit beside the face, never replace it.
briefs.motion: Shoulder-led trot with snout bob; casts align tusks, flick one forward, then stamp.

ability.name: Rail Flick
ability.field: Turn a tagged empty rail junction a quarter-turn; a carriage occupying it prevents movement and receives a clear refusal.
ability.combat: A committed narrow metal tongue reaches36px for3 damage with long settle; side flanks stay exposed and the player never dashes.

briefs.name: Furlace
briefs.silhouette: A pale green lacewing with two broad scalloped net wings held sideways, an expressive small head and two forked antennae; six little feet hang below its continuous body.
briefs.motion: Wing tips alternately dip above a grounded shadow; casts fold to a narrow pleat, unfold a shelter arc, then shake it closed.

ability.name: Leaf Shelter
ability.field: Unfold one tagged woven screen without covering the nearby nesting aperture; only the marked hinged frame changes state.
ability.combat: A small stationary arc cancels at most one ordinary hostile shot and gives one contact hit for1; no invulnerability, boss cancellation or permanent shield.

briefs.name: Kilnspoke
briefs.silhouette: A rust-red scorpion with two narrow blunt claws, four readable leg pairs and a rounded warm lantern at the end of its single curved tail; large attentive eyes above its mouth.
briefs.motion: Leg pairs ripple while the tail counterbalances; casts lower claws, sweep the tail sideways, then curl it back.

ability.name: Backspark
ability.field: Ignite a marked side wick from its sheltered flank; the open front face is deliberately unreceptive and visibly patterned differently.
ability.combat: A quarter-arc starts beside the caster and sweeps behind for2 damage, leaving the forward lane empty; orientation changes only during the first8 updates.

briefs.name: Chalkox
briefs.silhouette: A compact chalk-white ox with a broad square muzzle, a hanging scalloped dewlap, two low crescent horns and four dark hooves; heavy rectangular outline distinct from the stone goats.
briefs.motion: Deliberate square steps; casts lower the dewlap, plant both forehooves, then raise the head.

ability.name: Still Hoof
ability.field: Hold a tagged balance plate at its current notch while the player operates an adjacent manual latch; hold ends with the cast and never seals an exit.
ability.combat: A short grounded frontal shove deals1 with extra ordinary-enemy stagger; no full-body armor or immunity. A rear attack remains effective.

briefs.name: Tinshear
briefs.silhouette: A dragonfly with four separate spatula-shaped metal wings, a long jointed tail and two huge soft eyes; no folded bird chest or mantis claws.
briefs.motion: Wings alternate in paired shallow strokes; casts draw them inward, sound two unequal clicks, then spread.

ability.name: Twin Click
ability.field: Open a marked resonant latch with a short-long visual pulse pattern; repeated brute-force casts reset only that latch, and the pattern is also painted.
ability.combat: Two narrow parallel strokes release at different times; choose facing early to place the gap. Maximum2 total per enemy; no damage in the visible gap.

briefs.name: Rippleback
briefs.silhouette: A flat round softshell turtle with a long flexible snout, four clearly separated paddle feet and one low translucent rim; no amber plates, clam valves or arch shell.
briefs.motion: Alternating paddles slide under the rim; casts lift the snout, splash outward twice, then tuck.

ability.name: Split Pour
ability.field: Fill two adjacent small marked bowls to their pictured unequal marks in a fixed sequence; an overflow lip visibly drains excess, without timers.
ability.combat: Two unequal splash discs land beside a short forward path; at most2 power objects and2 total damage per enemy. The empty center line stays safe.

briefs.name: Tetherasp
briefs.silhouette: A short leaf-green snake with a broad friendly wedge head and three joined leaf cuffs; its single bare tail rests outside an asymmetric S curve, with no metal collars or eel fins.
briefs.motion: A traveling S wave with head held steady; casts draw a cuff inward, lay one root seam, then smooth it flat.

ability.name: Root Stitch
ability.field: Grow one soft root strip along a marked cracked garden seam; it changes a tagged clue/work object only, never makes unbounded bridges or new solids.
ability.combat: A stationary short root strip damages a crossing ordinary enemy once for2 and briefly slows it; boss speed unchanged and no stacking slow.

briefs.name: Cymbalop
briefs.silhouette: A small pearl-gray rabbit with two broad round metal ears held at unequal angles, stubby soft paws and a tiny round tail; a short wide body distinguishes it from the long-eared dune mammal.
briefs.motion: Paired hindfoot hops with ears swinging in opposite directions; casts cup ears, clap one bright impulse, then bounce back.

ability.name: Bright Clap
ability.field: Turn a tagged light vane one stop after a matching manual counterweight is set; clapping against the marked stop does nothing and explains why.
ability.combat: A short expanding forward fan deals2, wide at its far edge and narrow near the caster; one contact per enemy and no wall penetration.
